groundwaterWell.name: Groundwater well
groundwaterWell.description: Pumps and treats water from a reliable underground source.

desalinationPlant.name: Desalination plant
desalinationPlant.description: Produces fresh water by removing salt from seawater.

greenhouse.name: Automated greenhouse
greenhouse.description: Grows high-value crops year-round in a controlled environment.

cropFarm.name: Mechanized crop farm
cropFarm.description: Produces staple calories from field-grown grain, legumes, and root crops. Its residue feeds biomass generators (+3% each).

poultryFarm.name: Poultry and egg farm
poultryFarm.description: Produces eggs and poultry in a controlled farming system.       Its manure fertilises crop farms (+2% each) and feeds biomass generators (+3% each).

aquacultureFarm.name: Recirculating fish farm
aquacultureFarm.description: Raises fish in tanks that filter and reuse most of their water. Nutrient-rich tank water feeds greenhouses (+3% each).

windTurbine.name: Wind turbine
windTurbine.description: Converts wind into electricity. Steel-heavy, with output tied to a good site. Neighbouring turbines share wake-free spacing and grid links (+1% each to every turbine).

biomassGenerator.name: Biomass generator
biomassGenerator.description: Burns crop residue and organic waste for steady electricity. Boosted by crop farms and poultry farms.

solarThermalPlant.name: Solar thermal plant
solarThermalPlant.description: Mirrors heat a fluid to drive turbines, with heat storage to run into the evening.

hydroTurbine.name: Hydroelectric plant
hydroTurbine.description: A 10 MW hydroelectric site averaging a 45% capacity factor, about 108,000 kWh daily over a year. Output follows the river's seasons and falls in drought years. The reservoir adds water storage and irrigates crop farms (+3% each) and its pumped storage firms up solar arrays and wind turbines (+2% each). Expensive and slow to build, but cheap to maintain.

geothermalPlant.name: Geothermal plant
geothermalPlant.description: A 5 MW geothermal plant averaging a 90% capacity factor, a steady 108,000 kWh daily whatever the weather. Waste heat warms greenhouses: each plant adds 5% to every greenhouse's output. Cheaper to build, but mineral scaling and corrosion make it costly to maintain, and suitable sites are scarce.

nuclearReactor.name: Nuclear reactor
nuclearReactor.description: A 1 GW reactor averaging a 90% capacity factor, producing about 21.6 million kWh daily. Its waste heat boosts each desalination plant (+10%).

coalPowerPlant.name: Coal-fired power station
coalPowerPlant.description: A 50 MW station producing up to 1.2 million kWh daily. Burns fuel equivalent to about 600 tonnes of coal per day at full output.

naturalGasPowerPlant.name: Natural-gas power station
naturalGasPowerPlant.description: A 25 MW station producing up to 600,000 kWh daily. Burns fuel equivalent to about 110,000 cubic metres of natural gas per day at full output.

fossilFuelMine.name: Fossil-fuel extraction site
fossilFuelMine.description: Extracts up to 22,320 GJ of fossil fuels per day from finite domestic deposits.

recycler.name: Materials recycler
recycler.description: Processes sorted waste into reusable construction feedstock.

scrapYard.name: Scrap sorting yard
scrapYard.description: Sorts and prepares locally recovered scrap for reuse as steel and components. Pre-sorted scrap boosts each electric arc furnace (+5%).

eWasteWorkshop.name: E-waste recovery workshop
eWasteWorkshop.description: Dismantles and sorts discarded electronics to recover reusable components and silicon-bearing parts. Recovered quartz-bearing glass boosts each quartz works (+5%).

electricArcFurnace.name: Electric arc furnace
electricArcFurnace.description: Melts sorted steel scrap into reusable metal stock.

quartzWorks.name: Quartz processing works
quartzWorks.description: Processes quartz-rich feedstock into silicon-bearing industrial material.

ironOreMine.name: Iron ore mine
ironOreMine.description: Extracts virgin iron ore, delivered as new steel stock. Depletes the ground's reserves.

rareMineralMine.name: Rare mineral mine
rareMineralMine.description: Extracts virgin minerals that feed component manufacturing. Depletes the ground's reserves.
